digest.component_or_area: rebar LLM Bedrock provider (native pydantic-ai integration)
propositions: Add a native AWS Bedrock provider that builds pydantic-ai's BedrockConverseModel via the ambient AWS credential chain, avoiding an OpenAI-compatible gateway proxy.
Prompt caching on Bedrock must set exactly two keys (bedrock_cache_instructions and bedrock_cache_tool_definitions) for parity with the Anthropic path, rejecting bedrock_cache_messages.
Bedrock caching is model-dependent and can fail silently while billing full input tokens, so rebar must WARN when caching was requested but both cache_read and cache_write counters are zero.

temperature is fatal (400 ValidationException) on some Bedrock models like us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-7, so a supports_temperature capability with an exact-model-id override table must withdraw it without stripping it from the good default.

A provider-agnostic helper must translate a 400/ValidationException naming a sampling parameter into an actionable LLMConfigError, keying on error content only, while leaving unrelated 400s as LLMUnavailableError.
Ship boto3 as a [bedrock] optional extra kept out of [agents] but added to dev so unit tests run in CI, with construction changes gated behind the runner.py split blocking task.
